title: Fly: the edge's certificates with a FlyV1 token
why: Jason, 2026-11-17, from the pre-flight: a Fly token made with "fly tokens create" or the dashboard reads "FlyV1 fm2_…"; Domains::fly sent it as "Bearer FlyV1 …", which Fly refuses, so businesses' own domains couldn't get their certificates. Now a token starting "FlyV1 " is sent as it is, and any other token as Bearer. The staging gate is unchanged. The pre-flight's Fly line already sends it the same way.
